d: An anthropomorphic wolf with ash-grey fur, a muscular build, and an adult maturity. The head features a tuft of sandy-blonde hair on top and narrow, sharp yellow eyes. The outfit consists of a dark grey scarf, a silver metallic pauldron on one shoulder, a cream-colored tunic with a red and orange striped fabric overlay at the waist, and silver armored greaves. A large, fluffy ash-grey tail is visible, and the character holds a long spear with a silver blade and brown shaft. BODY COLOR: ash-grey
